## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain skipped checks or use “documentation only” where applicable. Separate local/synthetic testing from supervised hardware verification; explicitly say if hardware behavior is untested.

## UI or controller impact

Describe UI changes, control/recovery changes, compatibility limits or data migrations. Use only empty-state or synthetic-data screenshots. Write “None” if this section does not apply.

## Before review

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/isrish/s22i-console/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept this PR focused.
- [ ] I reviewed the staged diff and ran the publication check.
- [ ] I included no private identifiers, real ride data, raw logs, credentials, APKs or signing keys.
- [ ] I preserved controller safeguards and documented any unverified hardware behavior, or this change does not affect them.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and retained required license notices.
